panels.description: Team activity and output for the selected tasks and time range. Working time uses CVAT's inactivity-aware send:working_time events.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  sumIf(if(duration > 0, toUInt64(duration), JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'working_time')), scope = 'send:working_time') AS worked_ms,
  sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope IN ('draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object')) + sumIf(JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'object_count'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS output_objects,
  sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope = 'propagate:object') + sumIf(JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'object_count'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS propagated_objects,
  sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope IN ('drag:object', 'resize:object', 'edit:mask')) AS object_edits
SELECT
  uniqExact(user_id) AS "Active users",
  round(worked_ms / 3600000, 1) AS "Hours worked",
  output_objects AS "Output objects",
  round(output_objects * 3600000.0 / nullIf(worked_ms, 0), 1) AS "Objects / hour",
  propagated_objects AS "Propagated objects",
  round(object_edits * 100.0 / nullIf(propagated_objects, 0), 1) AS "Edits / 100 propagated"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND scope IN ('send:working_time', 'draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object', 'drag:object', 'resize:object', 'edit:mask', 'run:sam2_inference')
  AND (-1 IN (${tasks}) OR task_id IN (${tasks}))

panels.title: Team overview

panels.description: Output includes drawn, pasted, traditionally propagated, and SAM2-tracked objects. Speed divides active working time by output. Edits count drag, resize, and auto-mask corrections; lower edit and delete rates indicate less rework.

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    coalesce(anyIf(user_name, user_name IS NOT NULL AND user_name != ''), concat('User #', toString(user_id))) AS user,
    sumIf(if(duration > 0, toUInt64(duration), JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'working_time')), scope = 'send:working_time') AS worked_ms,
    sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope IN ('draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object')) + sumIf(JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'object_count'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS output_objects,
    sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope = 'propagate:object') + sumIf(JSONExtractUInt(payload, 'object_count'), scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS propagated_objects,
    sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope IN ('drag:object', 'resize:object', 'edit:mask')) AS object_edits,
    sumIf(toUInt64(ifNull(`count`, 1)), scope = 'delete:object') AS deleted_objects,
    countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_tracking' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'outcome') = 'success') AS sam2_runs,
    countIf(scope = 'run:sam2_inference' AND JSONExtractString(payload, 'operation') = 'track') AS sam2_frames,
    uniqExactIf(job_id, job_id IS NOT NULL) AS jobs
  FROM events
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND scope IN ('send:working_time', 'draw:object', 'paste:object', 'propagate:object', 'drag:object', 'resize:object', 'edit:mask', 'delete:object', 'run:sam2_tracking', 'run:sam2_inference')
    AND (-1 IN (${tasks}) OR task_id IN (${tasks}))
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  user AS User,
  round(worked_ms / 3600000, 2) AS Worked,
  output_objects AS "Output objects",
  round(output_objects * 3600000.0 / nullIf(worked_ms, 0), 1) AS "Objects / hour",
  round(worked_ms / 1000.0 / nullIf(output_objects, 0), 1) AS "Seconds / object",
  propagated_objects AS Propagated,
  round(object_edits * 100.0 / nullIf(propagated_objects, 0), 1) AS "Edits / 100 propagated",
  round(deleted_objects * 100.0 / nullIf(output_objects, 0), 1) AS "Deletes / 100 objects",
  sam2_runs AS "SAM2 runs",
  sam2_frames AS "SAM2 frames",
  jobs AS Jobs
FROM user_metrics
WHERE worked_ms > 0 OR output_objects > 0 OR sam2_runs > 0
ORDER BY output_objects DESC, worked_ms DESC

panels.title: User scoreboard

list.definition:
SELECT
  task_id AS __value,
  concat('Task #', toString(task_id)) AS __text
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND task_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY task_id DESC
